# Requirements

1. Obtain Authentication of a JWT (JSON Web Token).
2. Log in to iNaturalist in your browser.
3. Navigate to https://www.inaturalist.org/users/api_token to retrieve a token.
4. Add the token to .Renviron file (e.g., Sys.getenv("INAT_TOKEN"))
5. Ensure your .Renviron file is in a .gitignore file

> NOTE: : iNaturalist JSON Web Tokens (JWT) expire after 24 hours.
> Because this script will run for roughly 7 days, the api_token
> variable will become invalid on Day 2

```{r}
#| label: check-token
readRenviron(".Renviron")
Sys.getenv("INAT_TOKEN")
SLEEP_RATE <- 8.75 # 8.75-second sleep time to avoid hitting daily API limits
```

# Identifications

Adds my identifications to confirm the taxonomic order of the observations I reviewed

```{r}
#| label: FX-post-ID
USER_NAME <- "iNat user: kmtorres" # allows iNat to reach out about API traffic concerns

post_inat_id <- function(row_data, token, log_file) {
  url <- "https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/identifications"

  obs_id <- row_data$observation_id
  taxon_id <- row_data$taxon_id

  body <- list(
    identification = list(
      observation_id = obs_id,
      taxon_id = taxon_id,
      current = TRUE,
      body = "Supporting Order-level ID (not disagreeing with finer IDs)"
    )
  )

  response <- POST(
    url = url,
    add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", token)),
    encode = "json",
    body = body,
    user_agent(USER_NAME)
  )

  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    row_data$posted_to_inat <- TRUE
    log_msg <- paste0(
      Sys.time(),
      " | Added ID (Taxon: ",
      taxon_id,
      ") to observation # ",
      obs_id
    )
  } else {
    # Attempt to extract error details from the API response
    error_msg <- tryCatch(
      {
        resp_content <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
        parsed <- fromJSON(resp_content)
        if (!is.null(parsed$error)) {
          paste(parsed$error, collapse = "; ")
        } else {
          paste(parsed$errors, collapse = "; ")
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        paste("HTTP Status Code:", status_code(response))
      }
    )

    log_msg <- paste0(
      Sys.time(),
      " | Failed to add ID to observation # ",
      obs_id,
      " - ERROR: ",
      error_msg
    )
    warning(log_msg)

    # If observation doesn't exist/deleted, mark as TRUE so future loops skip it
    if (str_detect(error_msg, "Observation can't be blank")) {
      row_data$posted_to_inat <- TRUE
    }
  }

  # Append log entry to file
  write(log_msg, file = log_file, append = TRUE)
  # Add delay to respect API rate limit
  Sys.sleep(SLEEP_RATE)
  return(row_data)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: prep-id-dataset
final_ids_to_post <- ETF_EPT_inat_df |>
  mutate(
    posted_to_inat = FALSE,
    taxon_id = case_when(
      species == "Ephemeroptera" ~ 48011,
      species == "Plecoptera" ~ 47504,
      species == "Trichoptera" ~ 62164
    ),
    row_num = row_number(),
    batch_id = (row_num - 1) %/% 9900
  ) |>
  select(species, observation_id, taxon_id, posted_to_inat, row_num, batch_id)
```

```{r}
#| label: new-upload-inat-ids
# Read in unposted observations in the up-to-date dataset
final_ids_to_post_master <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds"
))

unposted_ids <- final_ids_to_post_master |>
  filter(posted_to_inat == FALSE)

# Grabs first batch number available
current_batch_num <- min(unposted_ids$batch_id, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter to today's uploads
ids_for_today <- unposted_ids |>
  filter(batch_id == current_batch_num)

# Log start
identification_log <- here(L301_data_dir, "301c_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_log.txt")

start_msg <- paste0(
  Sys.time(),
  " | Executing upload for Batch ID: ",
  current_batch_num
)

message(start_msg)
write(start_msg, file = identification_log, append = TRUE)


# ==============================================================================
# REPLACED LOOP: Incremental saving loop (Saves progress every 100 iterations)
# ==============================================================================

updated_rows <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ids_for_today))) {
  row_result <- post_inat_id(
    ids_for_today[i, ],
    token = Sys.getenv("INAT_TOKEN"),
    log_file = identification_log
  )

  updated_rows[[i]] <- row_result

  # Checkpoint save to disk every 100 uploads OR on the very last row
  if (i %% 100 == 0 || i == nrow(ids_for_today)) {
    checkpoint_df <- bind_rows(updated_rows)

    # Safely merge checkpoint back into the master dataset in memory
    final_ids_to_post_master <- final_ids_to_post_master |>
      rows_update(checkpoint_df, by = c("species", "observation_id"))

    # Overwrite the saved RDS file with incremental progress
    saveRDS(
      final_ids_to_post_master,
      here(L301_data_dir, "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds")
    )
  }
}

# Log end
end_msg <- paste0(
  Sys.time(),
  " | Batch ID ",
  current_batch_num,
  " complete! Master RDS updated."
)

message(end_msg)
write(end_msg, file = identification_log, append = TRUE)
```



```{r}
#| label: clean-up-env
rm(
  final_ids_to_post_master,
  unposted_ids,
  current_batch_num,
  ids_for_today,
  identification_log,
  start_msg,
  updated_ids,
  reconciled_master,
  end_msg
)
```


## Check IDs

Recover IDs not added to main dataset if error occurs

```{r}
#| label: recover-ids
# 1. Read log lines
log_lines <- readLines(here(L301_data_dir, "301c_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_log.txt"))

# 2. Filter for success lines and extract the observation numbers
# Matches lines like: "... | Added ID (Taxon: 48011) to observation # 12345678"
successful_obs_ids <- log_lines |>
  keep(~ str_detect(.x, "Added ID")) |>
  str_extract("observation # \\d+") |>
  str_remove("observation # ") |>
  as.numeric()

# 3. Read your existing master tracking dataset
final_ids_to_post_master <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds"
))

# 4. Mark posted_to_inat as TRUE for all successfully logged observation IDs
reconciled_ids_master <- final_ids_to_post_master |>
  mutate(
    posted_to_inat = if_else(
      observation_id %in% successful_obs_ids,
      TRUE,
      posted_to_inat
    )
  )

# Verify how many were updated
cat(
  "Total successfully posted according to log:",
  length(successful_obs_ids),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Total rows marked TRUE in dataset:",
  sum(reconciled_ids_master$posted_to_inat),
  "\n"
)

# 5. Overwrite the saved RDS file with the updated status
saveRDS(
  reconciled_ids_master,
  here(L301_data_dir, "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds")
)
```

# Annotations

Adds my annotations to confirm the life stage and evidence of presence of the observations I reviewed


Is it worth going back and reviewing images as subimago vs adult?
for ephemeroptera ^

Ephemeroptera adults won't get life stage,
unless they were associated with evidence,
which indicates a subimago molt evidence

For Trichoptera, I need to distinguish pupae

* Ephemeroptera:
  * life stage: `term_id=1`
    * adult + evidence = subimago `&term_value_id=16` (&molt presence)
    * nymph/larvae = nypmph `&term_value_id=5`
    * adult `&term_value_id=2`
  * presence: `term_id=22`
    * organism: `&term_value_id=24`
    * molt: `&term_value_id=28`

* Plecoptera
  * life stage: `term_id=1`
    * adult `&term_value_id=2`
    * nymph = nymph `&term_value_id=5`
  * prsence: `?term_id=22`
    * organism: `&term_value_id=24`

* Trichoptera
  * life stage: `term_id=1`
    * adult `&term_value_id=2`
    * larvae = larvae `&term_value_id=6`
    * egg `&term_value_id=7`
  * prsence: `?term_id=22`
    * organism: `&term_value_id=24`
    * construction : `&term_value_id=35`



```{r}
#| label: FX-post-annotation
post_inat_annotation <- function(row_data, token, log_file) {
  url <- "https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/annotations"

  obs_id <- row_data$observation_id
  attr_id <- row_data$controlled_attribute_id
  val_id <- row_data$controlled_value_id

  body <- list(
    annotation = list(
      resource_type = "Observation",
      resource_id = obs_id,
      controlled_attribute_id = attr_id,
      controlled_value_id = val_id
    )
  )

  response <- POST(
    url = url,
    add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", token)),
    encode = "json",
    body = body,
    user_agent(USER_NAME)
  )

  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    row_data$posted_to_inat <- TRUE
    log_msg <- paste0(
      Sys.time(),
      " | Added Annotation (Attr: ",
      attr_id,
      ", Val: ",
      val_id,
      ") to observation # ",
      obs_id
    )
  } else {
    # Attempt to extract error details from the API response
    error_msg <- tryCatch(
      {
        resp_content <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
        parsed <- fromJSON(resp_content)
        if (!is.null(parsed$error)) {
          paste(parsed$error, collapse = "; ")
        } else {
          paste(parsed$errors, collapse = "; ")
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        paste("HTTP Status Code:", status_code(response))
      }
    )

    log_msg <- paste0(
      Sys.time(),
      " | Failed to add Annotation to observation # ",
      obs_id,
      " - ERROR: ",
      error_msg
    )
    warning(log_msg)
  }

  # Append log entry to file
  write(log_msg, file = log_file, append = TRUE)
  # Add delay to respect API rate limit
  Sys.sleep(SLEEP_RATE)
  return(row_data)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: curate-datasets
# Curate datasets to add annotations back to iNat

#Ephemeroptera
ephemeroptera_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df |>
  filter(species == "Ephemeroptera") |>
  select(
    species,
    life_stage,
    evidence_type,
    observation_id,
    annotations,
    identifications_count
  ) |>
  mutate(
    posted_to_inat = FALSE,
    taxon_id = 48011,

    # Add Life Stage (term_id = 1)
    life_stage_val = case_when(
      life_stage == "adult" & evidence_type == "nymph to adult exuviae" ~ 16, # Subimago
      life_stage == "adult" & evidence_type == "organism" ~ NA_real_, # did not distinguish adults/subimago
      life_stage == "nymph/larvae" ~ 5, # Nymph
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Add Presence (term_id = 22)
    presence_val = case_when(
      evidence_type == "nymph to adult exuviae" ~ 28, # Molt
      evidence_type == "nymph-related evidence" ~ 28, # Molt
      evidence_type == "organism" ~ 24, # Organism
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  # Pivot longer so that each row represents exactly ONE distinct annotation payload
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(life_stage_val, presence_val),
    names_to = "attribute_type",
    values_to = "controlled_value_id",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    controlled_attribute_id = case_when(
      attribute_type == "life_stage_val" ~ 1,
      attribute_type == "presence_val" ~ 22
    )
  ) |>
  select(-attribute_type)


# Plecoptera
plecoptera_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df |>
  filter(species == "Plecoptera") |>
  select(
    species,
    life_stage,
    evidence_type,
    observation_id,
    annotations,
    identifications_count
  ) |>
  mutate(
    posted_to_inat = FALSE,
    taxon_id = 47504,

    # Add Life Stage (term_id = 1)
    life_stage_val = case_when(
      life_stage == "adult" & evidence_type == "organism" ~ 2, # Adult
      life_stage == "nymph/larvae" ~ 5, # Nymph
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Add Presence (term_id = 22)
    presence_val = case_when(
      evidence_type == "nymph to adult exuviae" ~ 28, # Molt
      evidence_type == "nymph-related evidence" ~ 28, # Molt
      evidence_type == "organism" ~ 24, # Organism
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(life_stage_val, presence_val),
    names_to = "attribute_type",
    values_to = "controlled_value_id",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    controlled_attribute_id = case_when(
      attribute_type == "life_stage_val" ~ 1,
      attribute_type == "presence_val" ~ 22
    )
  ) |>
  select(-attribute_type)

# Trichoptera
trichoptera_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df |>
  filter(species == "Trichoptera") |>
  select(
    species,
    life_stage,
    evidence_type,
    observation_id,
    annotations,
    identifications_count
  ) |>
  mutate(
    posted_to_inat = FALSE,
    taxon_id = 62164,

    # Map Life Stage (term_id = 1)
    life_stage_val = case_when(
      life_stage == "adult" & evidence_type == "organism" ~ 2, # Adult
      life_stage == "nymph/larvae" ~ 6, # Larvae
      life_stage == "eggs" ~ 7, # Egg
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Map Presence (term_id = 22)
    presence_val = case_when(
      evidence_type == "organism" ~ 24, # Organism
      evidence_type == "nymph-related evidence" ~ 35, # Construction (Caddisfly Case)
      evidence_type == "nymph to adult exuviae" ~ 28, # Molt
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(life_stage_val, presence_val),
    names_to = "attribute_type",
    values_to = "controlled_value_id",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    controlled_attribute_id = case_when(
      attribute_type == "life_stage_val" ~ 1,
      attribute_type == "presence_val" ~ 22
    )
  ) |>
  select(-attribute_type)
```

## Run uploads

```{r}
#| label: upload-inat-ann
# Read in unposted observations in the up-to-date dataset
final_ann_to_post_master <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301e_ETF_EPT_ANN_api_uploads.rds"
))

unposted_ann <- final_ann_to_post_master |>
  filter(posted_to_inat == FALSE)

# Grabs first batch number available
current_batch_num <- min(unposted_ann$batch_id, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter to today's uploads
ann_for_today <- unposted_ann |>
  filter(batch_id == current_batch_num)


# Log start
annotation_log <- here(L301_data_dir, "301f_ETF_EPT_ANN_api_log.txt")

start_msg <- paste0(
  Sys.time(),
  " | Executing upload for Batch ID: ",
  current_batch_num
)

message(start_msg)
write(start_msg, file = annotation_log, append = TRUE)


# Run the Annotation loop
updated_ann <- split(
  ann_for_today,
  seq_len(nrow(ann_for_today))
) |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ post_inat_annotation(
      .x,
      token = Sys.getenv("INAT_TOKEN"),
      log_file = annotation_log

# Add today's progress back to main dataset:
reconciled_master <- final_ann_to_post_master |>
  rows_update(updated_ann, by = "observation_id")

saveRDS(
  reconciled_master,
  here(L301_data_dir, "301e_ETF_EPT_ANN_api_uploads.rds")
)

# Log end
end_msg <- paste0(
  Sys.time(),
  " | Master RDS saved successfully for Batch ID: ",
  current_batch_num
)

message(end_msg)
write(end_msg, file = annotation_log, append = TRUE)
```

# Project

[Traditional project on iNaturalist](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/2025-status-of-eastern-usa-ept) 

This project curates a list of Ephemeroptera, Plecoptera, and Trichoptera observations from 2000-2025 in the EPA Level I ecoregion Eastern Temperate Forests. Observations included in this project are currently being used to study aquatic insects across the Eastern U.S.A as part of my Master's thesis research.


```{r}
#| label: FX-add-project
post_obs_to_project <- function(row_data, token, log_file, project_id) {
  url <- "https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/project_observations"

  obs_id <- row_data$observation_id

  body <- list(
    project_observation = list(
      observation_id = as.integer(obs_id),
      project_id = project_id
    )
  )

  # Execute request
  response <- POST(
    url = url,
    add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", token)),
    encode = "json",
    body = body,
    user_agent(USER_NAME)
  )

  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    row_data$posted_to_inat <- TRUE
    log_msg <- paste0(
      Sys.time(),
      " | [SUCCESS] Added observation # ",
      obs_id,
      " to project: ",
      project_id
    )
  } else {
    # Attempt to extract error details from the API response
    error_msg <- tryCatch(
      {
        resp_content <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
        parsed <- fromJSON(resp_content)
        if (!is.null(parsed$error)) {
          paste(parsed$error, collapse = "; ")
        } else {
          paste(parsed$errors, collapse = "; ")
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        paste("HTTP Status Code:", status_code(response))
      }
    )

    log_msg <- paste0(
      Sys.time(),
      " | [ERROR] Failed to add obs # ",
      obs_id,
      " - ERROR: ",
      error_msg
    )
    warning(log_msg)
  }

  # Append to project tracking log
  write(log_msg, file = log_file, append = TRUE)

  # Rate limit safety delay
  Sys.sleep(SLEEP_RATE)

  return(row_data)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: curate-obs-dataset
final_proj_to_post <- ETF_EPT_inat_df |>
  mutate(
    posted_to_inat = FALSE,
    taxon_id = case_when(
      species == "Ephemeroptera" ~ 48011,
      species == "Plecoptera" ~ 47504,
      species == "Trichoptera" ~ 62164
    ),
    row_num = row_number(),
    batch_id = (row_num - 1) %/% 9900
  ) |>
  select(
    species,
    observation_id,
    taxon_id,
    posted_to_inat,
    row_num,
    batch_id
  ) |>
  na.omit() |>
  distinct()
```



```{r}

saveRDS(

  here(L301_data_dir, "301g_ETF_EPT_project_api_prep.rds")

# Dataset for upload tracking

rm(final_proj_to_post)
```

## Run uploads

```{r}
#| label: upload-inat-proj
# Read in unposted observations in the up-to-date dataset
final_proj_to_post_master <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301h_ETF_EPT_project_api_uploads.rds"
))

unposted_proj <- final_proj_to_post_master |>
  filter(posted_to_inat == FALSE)

# Grabs first batch number available
current_batch_num <- min(unposted_proj$batch_id, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter to today's uploads
proj_for_today <- unposted_proj |>
  filter(batch_id == current_batch_num)


# Log start
project_id <- 300755
project_log <- here(L301_data_dir, "301i_ETF_EPT_project_api_log.txt")

start_msg <- paste0(
  Sys.time(),
  " | Executing upload for Batch ID: ",
  current_batch_num
)

message(start_msg)
write(start_msg, file = project_log, append = TRUE)


# Run the project loop
updated_proj <- split(
  proj_for_today,
  seq_len(nrow(proj_for_today))
) |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ post_obs_to_project(
      row_data = .x,
      token = Sys.getenv("INAT_TOKEN"),
      log_file = project_log,
      project_id = project_id
    )
  )

# Add today's progress back to main dataset:
reconciled_master <- final_proj_to_post_master |>
  rows_update(updated_project_status, by = "observation_id")

saveRDS(
  reconciled_master,
  here(L301_data_dir, "301h_ETF_EPT_project_api_uploads.rds")
)

# Log end
end_msg <- paste0(
  Sys.time(),
  " | Master RDS saved successfully for Batch ID: ",
  current_batch_num
)

message(end_msg)
write(end_msg, file = project_log, append = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: clean-up-env
rm(
  final_proj_to_post_master,
  unposted_proj,
  current_batch_num,
  proj_for_today,
  project_log,
  start_msg,
  updated_proj,
  reconciled_master,
  end_msg
)
```
